description: A donut chart showing how a total splits into parts, with a title and a legend

title.description: Title text on top of the widget

legend.description: Description text shown below the chart

slices.description: The parts that make up the whole. Six is the practical limit: the palette has six slots, and past that colours repeat and the slices get too thin to label cleanly. For more categories than that, use base/reports/barWidget, which carries magnitude by bar length and so has no such limit.

label.description: Name of this part, shown next to its slice

value.description: Value of this part, in any unit; shares are computed from the total

colour.description: Colour of this slice (optional). When omitted, slices are coloured from a validated categorical palette in order.

title: Report
